Name: Sandy vanilla with seasonal outfits (reuploaded and edited)
Author: MeloHola123
Description:
TW: I MUST CLARIFY THAT THE ORIGINAL MOD BELONGS TO [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] AND THE HAIR PIECES CREATED BY [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tanpoponoko]Tanpoponoko[/url] HAVE BEEN REPLACED BECAUSE THE CREATOR PROHIBITS THEIR USE.

This mod includes Sandy's vanilla portrait design but with outfits from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿. All hair pieces have been replaced with new ones.

[size=3][b][i][u]IMPORTANT, YOU MUST INSTALL SEASONAL OUTFITS  MOD FIRST IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK.[/u][/i][/b][/size]

[size=5][b]Changes in the portrait:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Changes in Sandy's portraits for spring, summer, fall, winter and all festivals, with her vanilla desing.
[*]New hairstyles and new hair pieces
[*]Her sprites wasn't updated, but I plan to do so in the future.
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to install it?[/b][/size]

[size=2]First of all, you need to have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod installed. Copy the "assets" folder into the Seasonal Outfits mod folder and overwrite all changes. Then r[/size][size=2]un the game as normal and that's all! [/size]

[size=5][b]Credits
[/b][/size]All credit for the original mod and portraits goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].

The content created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tanpoponoko]Tanpoponoko[/url] was replaced and removed with new, original content, as requested by the author in their profile description. I apologize for not informing myself earlier about their terms regarding their mods and work.

[size=2]I hope you enjoy this mod![/size]

[u][size=3]My first language isn't English, so I hope everything is clear. Thank you for your attention![/size][/u][size=2]
[/size]
[list]
[/list]
